All existing decking boards are to be removed and disposed of. Supply and install new Merbau decking boards (90mm x 19mm) across 100% of the deck area, fixed using stainless steel screws and installed to achieve a flat, consistent and high-quality finish.

In addition to the original scope, 100% of existing joists are to be structurally reinforced by twinning with new H3 external grade timber joists. Joist protection tape is to be applied to all joists to improve durability and longevity.

Deck framing is to be packed, adjusted and supported where required to ensure a level and even finished surface.

Extra Over – Entry Deck Section

Carry out full replacement of all existing decking boards to the nominated Entry Deck area, superseding the previously allowed partial board replacement.

All existing decking boards are to be removed and disposed of. Supply and install new Merbau decking boards (90mm x 19mm) across 100% of the deck area, fixed using stainless steel screws and installed to achieve a flat, consistent and high-quality finish.

In addition to the original scope, 100% of existing joists are to be removed and replaced with new H3 external grade timber joists. Joist protection tape is to be applied to all joists to improve durability and longevity.

Deck framing is to be packed, adjusted and supported where required to ensure a level and even finished surface.

Extra Over – Garage Deck Section

Carry out full replacement of all existing decking boards to the nominated Garage Deck area, superseding the previously allowed partial repair works.

All existing decking boards are to be removed and disposed of. Supply and install new Merbau decking boards (90mm x 19mm) across 100% of the deck area, including the three (3) steps, fixed using stainless steel screws and installed to achieve a flat, consistent and high-quality finish.

In addition to the original scope, 100% of existing joists are to be structurally reinforced by twinning with new H3 external grade timber joists. Joist protection tape is to be applied to all joists to improve durability and longevity.

Deck framing is to be packed, adjusted and supported where required to ensure a level and even finished surface.

Extra Over - Pool Deck Section

Carry out repair works to the existing Spotted Gum decking (86mm x 19mm) to the nominated Pool Deck area measuring approximately 6.5m x 3.5m.

All deteriorated or unsuitable decking boards within this section are to be removed and disposed of. Replacement boards will be sourced from salvaged Spotted Gum decking boards recovered from the Garage, Dining and Entry Deck sections, with all reusable boards to be selected, prepared and reinstalled to achieve a consistent and seamless finish with the existing deck.

No new decking boards are to be supplied for this section.

In addition to the original scope, 100% of existing joists are to be structurally reinforced by twinning with new H3 external grade timber joists. Joist protection tape is to be applied to all joists to improve durability and longevity. Any existing joists measuring 200mm x 45mm are to be matched accordingly to maintain structural integrity.

Deck framing is to be packed, adjusted and supported where required to ensure a level and even finished surface.

Notes

It is noted that the small walkway section located between the Entry Deck and Garage Deck, wrapping around the house, has not been included in the measured areas or scope of works for any of the above-mentioned deck sections. This area is excluded from the current scope and may be assessed and quoted separately if required.

It is also noted that the handrail adjacent to the Dining Deck, as specifically outlined within the quote, has been included. However, all other handrails and associated posts across the project have been excluded from this scope and are to be reviewed and discussed at a later stage.

Raise Existing Floor Structure

Project Overview

Remove the existing timber floorboards and floor substrate within the affected area approximately 3.9m x 3.2m. Existing floor framing to be raised to align with the adjoining dining room floor level. Works include modification and packing of the existing subfloor structure, likely through raising existing floor joists using H2 treated 90x45 timber fixed to the existing framing system. Approximately 9 joists anticipated.

Minor trimming and boxing work to be carried out around the existing window and French door areas as required to accommodate the new finished floor height and provide clean transitions.

This scope applies to floor structure and framing works only up to floor level. Ceiling works are excluded from this scope. No painting included.

Notes

* Existing floor levels and framing conditions to be confirmed upon demolition.
* Any unforeseen structural defects or additional framing requirements discovered after opening the floor are excluded.
* Final floor sheeting and floor finish installation excluded unless otherwise specified.
* Painting excluded.
* Ceiling works excluded.
* Skirting removal and reinstatement excluded.

Owner to supply a small quantity of matching timber floorboards to allow for patching and reinstatement works where required if they can. To be purchased otherwise.

Damaged floor repairs 
Remove laminate flooring. Cut existing damage substrate flooring yellow tongue approx 2mx1m section. 
Replace with new yellow tongue boards to match with the rest of the playroom subfloor. 
Secure in place. Reinstate laminate flooring on top of new subfloor. Remove all damaged timber and recycle accordingly.

Exclusions: supply of new laminate flooring (existing could be saved when inspected)

Door Replacement & Custom VJ Door Installation

Project Overview
Removal of the existing door and jamb, followed by construction of a new clean-lined door opening and installation of a custom 860 x 2300 mm door with vertical VJ groove detail. Door to be fitted with client-supplied recessed handle and mortise lock for a flush, integrated finish.

Scope of Work

* Carefully remove and dispose of existing door, jamb, and associated hardware
* Prepare opening and adjust framing as required to suit new 860 x 2300 mm door size, ensuring plumb, level, and square reveals
* Construct and install new door jamb with clean, minimal profile
* Supply and install custom 860 x 2300 mm door leaf with vertical VJ groove detail
* Rout door to suit client-supplied handle and mortise lock
* Install mortise lock mechanism and recess handle flush into door
* Hang door, align, and adjust for smooth operation and consistent margins
* Install hinges and all required hardware
* Final checks, adjustments, and site clean-up

Notes

* Handle and lock hardware supplied by client
* Painting excluded
* Any unforeseen structural modifications or wall repairs not included

Stainless Steel Wire Trellis System Installation

Project Overview
Supply and installation of a stainless steel wire system to act as a structured guide for climbing plants, creating a natural privacy screen. Works include preparation of mounting surfaces and removal of existing fixtures or window elements where required to accommodate the system.

Scope of Work

* Inspect site and confirm layout, fixing points, and wire configuration for optimal plant coverage and privacy
* Carefully remove existing window fixtures, fittings, or obstructions where required to allow installation (make safe and dispose)
* Prepare wall or structural surfaces, including patching and making good fixing areas where necessary
* Supply and install stainless steel wire trellis system (marine-grade cables, end fittings, and tensioners)
* Set out vertical and/or horizontal wire runs to suit climbing plant growth pattern
* Secure all fixings into appropriate structural elements (masonry, timber framing, or steel)
* Tension wires to achieve straight, uniform lines with appropriate spacing
* Ensure system is installed with adequate stand-off from wall to allow plant growth and airflow
* Final inspection, adjustment of tension, and site clean-up

Notes

* Design allows for future plant growth; plants not included
* Removal limited to accessible fixtures only; structural alterations excluded unless noted
* Making good limited to fixing points; full wall refinishing excluded
* Painting excluded

Supply and Installation of Solid Core External Door

Scope of Work
Supply and install one solid core external door. Works include removal of the existing door, preparation and hanging of the new door to the existing frame, and refitting of all existing hardware including hinges, handle and latch/lock set. Door to be trimmed and adjusted as required to achieve correct clearances, alignment and smooth operation.

Notes
	•	Existing hardware to be reused.
	•	Minor adjustments to door and frame included to ensure proper fit and operation.
	•	Works assume existing frame is structurally sound and suitable for reuse.

Installation of Ventilation Grille to Bathroom Door

Scope of Work
Supply and install one 300 x 300 ventilation grille to an existing melamine bathroom door. Works include setting out, cutting opening to suit grille size, fitting the grille and securing in place to provide ventilation through the door.

Notes
	•	Works assume the existing door is suitable for modification.
	•	Minor trimming and adjustments included to achieve a neat fit.

Optional – Replacement of Bathroom Melamine Door

Scope of Work
Supply and install one new melamine bathroom door to replace the existing door. Works include removal of the existing door, supply of new melamine door, preparation and hanging to the existing frame, and refitting of existing hardware including hinges and handle. Door to be trimmed and adjusted as required to achieve correct alignment and smooth operation.

Notes
	•	Existing hardware to be reused.
	•	Works assume the existing frame and hardware are suitable for reuse.
	•	Removal and disposal of the existing door included.

Stainless Steel Wire Balustrade

Project Overview

Supply and install a stainless steel wire balustrade system approximately 4.5m + 1.9m in length. Works include installation of new 90x90 timber posts set into concrete footings, installation of horizontal 140x45 timber rails, and fitting of stainless steel wire cabling with associated tensioning fittings and hardware.

Balustrade to include approximately 8 horizontal stainless steel wire strands fixed and tensioned between posts to create a clean and modern finish suitable for boundary or fall protection applications.

All components to be aligned, levelled, and securely fixed in place.

Notes

* Final post locations and footing depths subject to site conditions.
* Minor excavation for footings included.
* Painting, staining, or oiling excluded unless otherwise specified.
* Any council approvals or engineering certification excluded.
* Existing surface repairs or landscaping reinstatement excluded.

Composite Deck Landing

Project Overview

Construct a small landing platform approximately 610mm x 920mm finished in composite decking boards. Works include fabrication and installation of a suitable structural frame and fixing of composite decking boards with concealed or colour-matched fixings where applicable.

Landing to be installed level, securely fixed, and neatly finished with wrapped composite trim edges to provide a clean and consistent appearance on all exposed faces.

Minor trimming and fitting to adjacent surfaces included as required for a neat installation.

Notes

* Composite decking colour and profile to be selected prior to commencement.
* Existing surface levels and fixing conditions to be confirmed on site.
* Painting excluded.
* Electrical, plumbing, waterproofing, and drainage works excluded unless otherwise specified.

Wrap Around Deck

Project Overview

Removal of existing spotted gum decking boards and inspection of existing subframe. Repair and strengthen existing joists by twinning where required, followed by installation of new 90x18mm Merbau decking boards fixed with stainless steel decking screws to the existing wrap around deck areas outlined below.

Deck areas included within scope:

* 2.5m x 1.4m
* 1.7m x 1.5m
* Triangular section approximately 1.6m x 1.6m
* 7.9m x 1.8m

Approximate total deck area: 21.55m²

Notes

* Remove and dispose of existing spotted gum decking boards.
* Inspect existing joists and supporting frame for defects or deterioration.
* Repair and twin existing joists throughout deck where required to provide suitable support for new decking installation.
* Supply and install new H3 treated timber where required for repairs.
* Apply joist protection tape to all joist tops prior to decking installation.
* Supply and install new 90x18mm Merbau decking boards.
* Decking boards to be installed with approximately 3.2mm spacing.
* Decking boards to be fixed using stainless steel decking screws, 2 screws per joist intersection.
* Allow for trimming and finishing of deck edges for a clean overall appearance.
* Approximate joist repairs and twinning allowance based on existing joists at 450mm spacing.
* Painting, oiling and staining excluded unless noted otherwise.

Handrail Installation

Project Overview
Supply and install a wall-mounted handrail (profile as per referenced images) approximately 1800mm in length. Handrail to be fixed to wall using 2–3 matte black brackets as selected from attached references. Installation to ensure secure fixing into suitable wall framing or masonry, aligned and level along the wall.

Notes

* Handrail profile and bracket type to match selections provided in quoted images
* Final bracket quantity (2 or 3) to be confirmed based on site conditions and span
* Paint finish excluded (handrail to be painted by others)
* All fixings and installation included
* Assumes suitable wall structure for fixing; any additional backing or reinforcement not included
Paint matte black 2 coats

Double Door Opening Reduction & Door Installation

Reduce existing 1640mm wide opening and construct new framed wall sections using H2 treated timber to reduce the opening size and suit installation of 2 x 600mm doors.

Existing door jambs, architraves, and timber trims to be carefully removed, modified where required, and reused/reinstalled to suit the new opening configuration. No new door jambs included in scope.

Hang and fit 2 x 600mm doors to the adjusted opening. Scope assumes supplied door profiles are already rebated and suitable for French door configuration.

Extend and reinstate skirting boards to suit the updated wall and door layout using skirting supplied by others/on site.

Works exclude plastering, setting, and painting, with gyprock/plaster works to be completed by others. No insulation required within the new wall section.

Supply & Install – External Doors, Hardware & Site Safety

External Doors

	•	Supply and install two (2) solid core external doors (2030 × 623mm per leaf)
	•	Supply and install four (4) fixed hinges, satin chrome finish
	•	Supply and install one (1) Lockwood 002DX Digital DX Deadlatch, satin chrome (outward opening)
	•	Supply and install two (2) flush lock pins/bolts, satin chrome, to inactive door leaf (top and bottom)
	•	Remove and dispose of existing door from site

Paint Finish – Doors & Frame

	•	Prime all door faces and sides with Dulux Precision Max Adhesion primer (applied over factory green primer, offsite)
	•	Apply two (2) coats Dulux exterior topcoat to door faces, sides and existing door frame (colour TBC)

Garage Door Security

	•	Supply and install two (2) long shoot pad bolts to roller shutter (one each side), bolt fixed to shutter and inserted into masonry wall to secure in closed position

Fire Safety (units supplied by others)

	•	Install one (1) fire extinguisher to wall (2 fixings)
	•	Install one (1) fire blanket to wall (2 fixings)

Solid Core Door Adjustment & Refit

Project Overview

Remove existing solid core door from hinges and plane/shave door edges as required to achieve correct clearance and operation within existing frame. Refit and hang door using existing hardware and ensure smooth opening and closing.

Prepare shaved sections and apply matching paint finish to exposed timber areas for a neat and consistent appearance.

Materials — SS316 Wire Balustrade System (6 lineal metres)

• 5 × SS316 square hollow section posts 50×50×3mm with welded base flanges
• 10 runs × 3.2mm SS316 marine-grade wire rope (approx. 7m per run)
• SS316 swaged jaw-end fittings and jaw/jaw turnbuckles with locking nuts (20 sets)
• 90×42mm clear-grade hardwood handrail 6.5m (finger-jointed, primed, ready to paint)
• Post cap plates (stainless), wall-end anchor plates and cover escutcheons
• Stainless A4 fixings, chemical anchors, construction adhesive, paintable gap sealant

Labour — Fabrication, Installation & Commissioning (approx. 18 hrs)

1. Set out and mark post positions in accordance with site dimensions and balustrade drawing
2. Drill substrate and chemically anchor base flanges (concrete anchor bolts where required)
3. Plumb, align and fix posts — check for level and true vertical on all axes
4. Thread all wire runs through posts, tension evenly and lock off with swaged fittings
5. Adjust turnbuckles to achieve uniform tension across all runs; verify 100mm max deflection compliance
6. Cut, shape and fix hardwood handrail to posts with countersunk stainless screws
7. Fill and seal all penetrations, clean down all stainless surfaces
8. Final inspection, tension re-check and client handover
